description: Laser cutting + CNC bending of sheet metal. Values are transcribed from SendCutSend's published tables (retrieved 2026-10-20); nothing is inferred.

research.notes: Retrieved: bending calculator specs table, processing min/max chart, sheet-cutting, bending and bend-deformation guidelines, mild steel page. Not published/retrieved: hole-to-edge distance, feature-to-feature spacing, per-material minimum hole sizes, per-material cut tolerances other than mild steel.

tolerances.text: Laser cut tolerance +/-0.005 in across .030-.500 in (mild steel)
Sheet metal bend angle tolerance +/-1 deg (bends up to 24 in), +/-2 deg (longer)
Bend-to-edge tolerance +/-0.015 in (each additional bend adds at least 0.015 in)

restrictions.text: U/C-channel: base must be at least 2x the flange length (sheet metal).
3/4-sided boxes without hardware: max flange length 5 in; flanges 3.5-5 in need min flange width 1.1 in; with hardware max 3.00 in.

Cannot bend: acute angles greater than 130 deg, obtuse angles less than 5 deg; no curl/bump/roll forming, coining or hemming. 'Max bend angle 130 deg' (angle convention not defined on the page, so not modelled).
STEP/STP uploads must contain a single solid sheet metal body; assemblies/multi-body files must be uploaded as separate files.
Model at stock thickness with SendCutSend's K-factor and bend radius, or the file can error with open contours.
Use square bend reliefs (not tapered/rounded) for STEP uploads.

notes: Hole-to-edge, feature-to-feature spacing and per-material hole minimums are not published in the retrieved pages.

source.note: Bending specification tables list the stocked thicknesses per material; N/A rows are not bendable.

rules.limitations: A thickness missing from the table is reported NEEDS_REVIEW (the list may not be exhaustive), only N/A rows FAIL.

rules.rationale: SendCutSend does not offer custom bend radii; radius and K-factor are set per material thickness, so parts must be designed with those values.

source.note: Table "Effective Bend Radius @ 90°". Tolerance 0.0127 mm = half of the last published digit (0.001 in).

rules.limitations: Published as the effective radius at 90 degrees; other angles are not separately published.

source.note: Table "Min Formed Flange Length @ 90°" (equals "Min Flange Length (After Bend)" in the min/max chart). The calculator page states formed flange lengths are measured from the apex of the bend.

rules.limitations: Published for 90-degree bends only; flanges at other angles give NEEDS_REVIEW. Apex length is computed from the measured tangent length, bend radius and angle.

rules.notes: Non-blocking by design: SendCutSend says features in the die area "are subject to distorting" and shows a feature distortion caution area at checkout; it does not say the part is rejected. A violation (or an unresolved case) is reported as a WARNING, the verdict becomes "conditionally compatible", and the warning stays listed. Change "consequence" to "blocking" to make it fail the part.
rules.rationale: Features inside the die width distort during bending (die lines); large cutouts in the die line can also shift the bend.

source.note: Keep cut features at least 1/2 the die width away from the centerline of each bend; die width per material/thickness from the bending specifications table.

rules.limitations: Measured to the bend centerline; the add-in measures to the bend tangent line and bounds the offset, so borderline cases give NEEDS_REVIEW.

rules.rationale: The pierce needs room; holes smaller than the minimum will distort, char, or fail to cut.

source.note: Laser cutting: "At least 50% of material thickness" for holes and cutouts. Metals are routed to laser cutting.

rules.limitations: The page states the exact minimum varies by material and thickness (listed on each material page, not retrieved); 50% is the general published value.
